AC Milan are a 46% home favourite (46/26/28), and the research splits rather than points one way. Benfica's form is the case against the price — second in the Primeira Liga on six straight league wins, with Vangelis Pavlidis on 14 goals in 11 matches, against a Milan side that has conceded 6 in 4 Serie A games and drawn its last two — but Marco Silva is reported on 15 Sep, the day the odds were taken, to be changing personnel in every line to rest players before the Porto derby, with right-back Alexander Bah out injured, a heavier rotation than Milan resting Modrić and benching De Winter. The two roughly cancel, so the home pick and confidence 3 are held at the market read, with the scoreline set at 2-1 rather than 1-0 because both previews surveyed land on both teams to score and over 2.5 goals.
predictions.disagreement: Tipsters split: Goal.com's preview gives a slight edge to Benfica on the form gap, against the market, while Football Whispers backs Milan 2-1 citing home advantage and Bah's absence. Both agree on an open, both-teams-score game.

Bournemouth are a narrow 38% away favourite over Real Sociedad (34/27/38), and the intel leans the other way: Bournemouth are confirmed without Éli Kroupi Jr (13 goals last season), Amine Adli, Julián Araujo and Veljko Milosavljević, and Marco Rose is expected to rotate — Di Gregorio in goal, Tyler Adams likely out of midfield — three days before hosting Liverpool, while Sociedad miss only Odriozola and the suspended Aramburu, with Zubeldia a doubt. None of that is a concrete unpriced reason to flip a four-point line set by 37 books: the absences were in previews the day before the odds were taken, the Liverpool fixture was always on the calendar, the expected rotation is milder than the eight changes Rose made in the League Cup, and Sociedad arrive off a 0-3 home defeat to Atlético Madrid with 11 conceded in six league games. The away pick stands, but confidence drops from 2 to 1 to record that the research points against the call, and the scoreline is 1-2 rather than 0-1 because both defences have been leaking.
predictions.disagreement: PenseBet's tipster backs Real Sociedad double chance (home or draw), citing home advantage, Oyarzabal and Guedes, Bournemouth's four injuries and their run of dropping points from winning positions — a lean against the market's Bournemouth edge.

The tightest line on the card (35/27/37), with Union Saint-Gilloise a hair ahead away from home. The research pulls both ways: Union are down to 13 fit outfield players and three recognised centre-backs (Kevin Mac Allister's ACL tear on top of earlier injuries, three suspensions carried over from qualifying, two players left off the European list), but they also co-lead the Belgian league unbeaten in 10, against a Plzeň side ninth in the Czech league in uneven form under new manager Radoslav Kováč. The squad news was in Belgian reporting on 14 Sep and rests largely on suspensions and a squad registration that predate the odds, so it is not a concrete unpriced reason to flip the pick — away pick and confidence 2 held at the market read, with the scoreline 1-2 rather than 0-1 because Plzeň have scored in nine straight home games and both teams have scored in all six of their home fixtures this season.
